title: Donkey Kong Bananza (DKB Recomp)
description: Static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2) to native Windows with Vulkan. 0.3.0 plays well past the first level on recent NVIDIA cards. On the bananza branch: AMD device loss fixed for testers, a heavy scene at about 58 fps (was 53), full-resolution 3D (scene_res). Roadmap: #10. No game
